column1: # AION 2 map names by map id, as the map load (21 36) carries it, and which
# are dungeons: an id of 600000 and up is one, named or not, and a row marked
# `dungeon` is one below it (game::is_dungeon). Every instance is marked but
# Chaotic Reshanta's and the open world's events'.
# (aion2.app/db/dungeons/<name>), one row per difficulty tier with its tier's
# which give each instance's map id and name every map aion2.app's pages do
# not give, the tier from the record's difficulty. Keyed by questlog.gg's map
# id, not the instance's own id where they differ: the arena capture's map 61
# is Impetusium Arena (instance 8) and the PvP capture's map 20 Chaotic Lower
# Reshanta (instance 21). Left out: the open world's phasing layers and story
# instances, whose names are the game's internal ones.
# Open-world zones have no public ids. The game's own files cannot be read for
# them (they are encrypted), and no site lists numeric ids for open-world maps.
# metabot.gg gives zone ids (Reshanta's Root is 622), but they look like zones
# within a map, not maps. Add rows by hand below as captures show them.
